definition: When a [player](/term/player) is in the opposing team’s area of map control. Due to the distance from their allies and the proximity of the opposing team, an overextending player is more vulnerable to a [gank](/term/gank) or [collapse](/term/collapse). Overextension is not necessarily a mistake, as it can [bait](/term/bait) the opposing team or apply map [pressure](/term/pressure).
